neighbours.label: the preposition that links a counted item to the unit or container it is counted in ('12 eggs per carton', 'the seeds in a melon'), as against the same preposition in a plain location or motion phrase
fire: The farm packs twelve eggs per carton and ships them every morning.
Each plant produces about forty flowers per stem in a good year.
Nobody knows exactly how many seeds are in a large watermelon.
The bus can seat two passengers per row on the upper deck.
This model allows only three users per account at the same time.
Count the number of beans in each jar and write it on the label.
There are usually four or five kernels per pod in this variety.
The recipe calls for two cloves of garlic per serving.
quiet: The farm packs eggs carefully and ships them every morning.
Each plant produces flowers along the stem in a good year.
Nobody knows exactly why the watermelon split in the sun.
The bus can seat passengers comfortably on the upper deck.
This model allows users to share an account at the same time.
Put the beans back in the cupboard and close the door.
The pods usually turn brown and dry in this variety.
The recipe calls for garlic and olive oil in the sauce.
